# Nox / Xcamp Frontend

Tenant-aware workspace shell for the Nox / Xcamp platform. Built with React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS. Lovable-compatible.

## Purpose

White-label, AI-first, MicroApp-based workspace platform with shell + modular feature architecture.

## Stack

- React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4
- React Router v7 — routing
- TanStack Query — server state
- Zustand — client/shell state
- react-i18next — EN / DE / ES
- Supabase JS — auth and database
- Zod + react-hook-form — validation
- Sonner — toasts
- lucide-react — icons

## Setup

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Fill in VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
npm run dev
```

## Environment variables

```
VITE_SUPABASE_URL=
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
VITE_BACKEND_API_URL=
VITE_VOX_API_URL=
VITE_DEFAULT_LOCALE=en
VITE_ENABLE_PUSH=false
```

## Architecture

**Fixed shell + modular feature system.**

```
src/
  app/          # Providers, router, guards, Zustand stores, config
  features/     # Feature modules (shell, auth, assistant, projects, objectives...)
  entities/     # Typed domain models (separate from DB row types)
  shared/       # UI primitives, hooks, utils, i18n, theme
  integrations/ # Supabase / Vox / backend adapters
  assets/       # Locale JSON files, icons, illustrations
  styles/       # CSS design tokens and globals
```

### Tenant manifest

`TenantManifest` controls branding, enabled apps, feature flags, localization, and policies. Currently loaded from mock. Replace the loader in `TenantProvider` to fetch from Supabase or backend.

### Left panel tabs

| Tab | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Companion | AI assistant (suggest / prepare / execute modes) |
| Apps | Manifest-filtered app navigation |
| Context | Current hierarchy breadcrumb |
| Inbox | Unified notifications |

### Routing groups

| Prefix | Area |
|---|---|
| `/auth/*` | Public auth pages |
| `/app/*` | Protected workspace |
| `/marketplace/*` | App and template marketplace |
| `/admin/*` | Admin area (role-gated) |
| `/settings/*` | User settings |
